title: paeonia × suffruticosa f. anneslei
intro: Paeonia × suffruticosa f. anneslei, commonly known as Tree Peony, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Paeoniaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia × suffruticosa f. anneslei are attributed to its ability to relax the muscles, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote wound healing, among other effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include paeonol, paeoniflorin, and paeoniflavin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
